name: Divinity of Pride
description: Demigod who was the kithkin seer in The Seer's Parables and answered the kithkin's question, driving him insane.

timeline.summary: In the Omens section of The Seer's Parables, the seer shed her skin, revealed herself as the Divinity of Pride, and answered the kithkin's question, driving him insane.
timeline.quote: the Kithkin seer sheds her skin to reveal that she is not a Kithkin at all
